cells.tense: The authority is here now, and you are holding the pen while the pattern holds together.
cells.ask: Say the next step out loud today, before every branch is mapped. Do one thing. Notice what holds tomorrow.
cells.core:
You take in a whole situation and know its shape without every piece in hand, and the call you make lands because you let it come rather than forcing the timing. People catch the calm before they hear the reason for it, and the room quiets around what you decide.

The whole and the next move are close together in you now. That is rare, and it is what the reading rides on. Speak the step before everything is settled. You don't have to announce the decision or defend it after. The structure carries the room whether or not you raise your voice for it.
cells.sheetLine: You see the whole pattern and stand steady inside it.
cells.verb: moving as structure itself, needing no announcement
cells.place: at the edge of the pattern, seeing the whole while inside it

cells.tense: You are leaning into a pattern that has not arrived yet, bracing for a shape you cannot write in.
cells.ask: Pick the nearest concrete thing and work only its next branch. Write down one pattern you can test tomorrow.
cells.core:
At its best this is reading the room once, naming what you see, and acting from it the same day. The call comes fast because the ground under it is solid, and nobody has to carry the plan for you.

Right now you are running ahead of the thing. You see the pattern forming and you are already organizing its end, arranging parts that have not arrived, holding a design nobody asked you to hold. What serves when it is here gets spent on what may not come. Work the nearest branch only. Test one piece tomorrow rather than defending the whole.

cells.tense: You are at a door that has already closed, still holding what came apart there.
cells.ask: Pick one small thing and build it solid this week. Shape it with your hands. Let the result stand on its own.
cells.core:
You take in a whole situation and know what it is without waiting on every piece, and you can act from that the same day without needing to argue it. That is the read at full strength, and it is what people feel when they stand near you.

What you get now is quieter than that. You take it in, and you don't move. The read is still there; the offering stopped. Build one small thing out of whatever is left, with your hands and your time. It doesn't have to be the big pattern. It has to be real and shaped and finished enough to stand.

cells.tense: You are already arranging what is around you, and you describe it as what the situation required.
cells.ask: Name one piece of structure you set up recently and say out loud that you set it. Own that one. Let the rest stay where it is.
cells.core:
You know the shape you are holding and you say so, so people can work with you instead of around something unnamed. The structure serves what it organizes, and things make sense near you because you can tell someone what you are doing with it.

What runs now is the arranging itself, in how you hold a room, what you let pass, which piece you move next. You call it the situation, the timing, just what made sense. Take one piece back and say the words. Not the whole pattern. One piece, named out loud by you.
